claims.text: Exdensur (depemokimab) = FDA-approved add-on maintenance tx of severe asthma w an eosinophilic phenotype, age ≥12.
claims.quote: the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Exdensur (depemokimab-ulaa) as an add-on maintenance treatment of severe asthma characterised by an eosinophilic phenotype in adult and paediatric patients aged 12 years and older.
depemokimab, a long-acting anti-IL5 delivered by injection every 26 weeks, which is approved for the treatment of severe eosinophilic asthma from age 12 years
